reason: Affects echo's reverse proxy middleware forwarding X-Real-IP. rauth does not use middleware.Proxy/ProxyWithConfig; client IPs come from rauth's own trusted-proxy handling. No fixed echo release yet.

Affects echo's default RealIP/IP extraction trusting spoofed X-Forwarded-For (e.g. in its RateLimiter). rauth installs its own IPExtractor (main.go CreateIPExtractor) that honours forwarding headers only from TRUSTED_PROXIES and does not use echo's RateLimiter. No fixed echo release yet.
